scenario_or_screen: UC-01-S04 / S06 quote page, online payment
steps: Customer opens the quote (priced as cash), selects 'Pay now online: E-wallet', presses Confirm order
actual: The quote page came back with 'The price changed since your quote' (HTTP 409) although nothing had changed; a second press was needed. The consent fingerprint binds the payment choice (BR-10) but was computed for cash
severity: medium (every online order started with a false warning)
decision: Small fix in template and app.js only: each press fetches the fingerprint of the chosen payment from /order/quote (writes nothing) and then sends the form; quoted_total is kept so a real price change is still caught. The sealed Python (P4 dependency policy) is untouched
regression_test: tests/test_p5_quote_payment_switch.py (3 tests; two fail without the fix). Browser behaviour: S6 step 6a.1 (no false notice)
rerun_result: all scenarios S1 to S8 rerun from a fresh database at 252ada1: 60 of 60 steps pass
